headings: Placing Customer Places a Sales Order - Online Checkout
text: Company will communicate to Customer all order information including what PLC specified and what Company calculated based on that. If everything looks correct and according to what PLC wants and/or needs, PLC will finalize the order, officially placing it with Company.
